name: NetBird
author: Tom Stian Ingebretson
description: NetBird connection and peer status for cloud or self-hosted networks in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Connect to NetBird, browse devices and proxies, and copy peer IPs from the bar.

schema.label: Management URL
schema.description: Optional self-hosted management server URL. Leave empty to use the NetBird profile or default server.

schema.label: Daemon address
schema.description: Optional custom NetBird daemon socket, e.g. unix:///run/netbird/default.sock. Leave empty for CLI discovery.
